question: What is the average delivery time in days from purchase to delivery, and what average delivery time does the SLA target?
answer:
**Average actual delivery time:** 12.56 days (from the database query).  
**SLA target for average delivery time:** Below 12 days (as defined in the SLA).

- The query returned an average of **12.56** days between `order_purchase_timestamp` and `order_delivered_customer_date` for delivered orders [database query].  
- The Service Level Agreement specifies the target “Average delivery time (purchase to delivery) Below 12 days” [delivery_sla.md].

RELEVANT TABLES:
Table orders: One row per order with its status and lifecycle timestamps. Central table of the database.
- order_id: Unique order identifier. Joins to order_items, order_payments and order_reviews.
- customer_id: Joins to customers.customer_id.
- order_status: One of created, approved, invoiced, processing, shipped, delivered, unavailable, canceled.
- order_purchase_timestamp: When the customer placed the order. Use this to assign orders to months.
- order_approved_at: When payment was approved. NULL if never approved.
- order_delivered_carrier_date: When the seller handed the parcel to the carrier. NULL if not shipped.
- order_delivered_customer_date: When the customer received the parcel. NULL if not delivered.
- order_estimated_delivery_date: Delivery date promised to the customer at checkout.
Table order_items: One row per product line in an order. An order with 3 items has 3 rows. Source of item revenue and freight.
- order_id: Joins to orders.order_id.
- order_item_id: Sequence number of the item within the order, starting at 1.
- product_id: Joins to products.product_id.
- seller_id: Joins to sellers.seller_id. The seller who fulfils this item.
- shipping_limit_date: Deadline for the seller to hand the item to the carrier.
- price: Item price in BRL, excluding freight.
- freight_value: Freight charge in BRL for this item.
Table order_reviews: Customer satisfaction reviews. review_id is not unique in the source data, and an order can have more than one review.
- review_id: Review identifier. Not guaranteed unique.
- order_id: Joins to orders.order_id.
- review_score: Integer rating 1 (very poor) to 5 (excellent). 1-2 negative, 4-5 positive.
- review_comment_title: Optional title in Portuguese. Often NULL.
- review_comment_message: Optional free-text comment in Portuguese. Often NULL; may contain personal details.
- review_creation_date: When the satisfaction survey was sent.
- review_answer_timestamp: When the customer answered the survey.
